correctness.rationale: At theta=pi/4, exact spectral-projector calculation reproduces the stated real order-four unitary, and the four orbit vectors give the exact stationary geometric mixture. The characteristic polynomial of the spin-flip product is z²(z²-Tz+P), with exact rational T and P and a positive square root on all 0<q<1. Thus Wootters concurrence is q(1-q)/(1+q²). For U^3 the odd orbit weights exchange but spin-flip spectral invariants are unchanged; U^2=I tensor sigma_x preserves product states and has zero concurrence. The derivative has one root in (0,1), q=sqrt(2)-1, yielding the claimed unique optimum. verify.py passes exact symbolic tests and ten independent numerical reconstructions. No empirical verification is used as proof of the whole domain.
